entries.text: You all ready to meet the Bloodmoon Beast?[VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_0050_camera_01

entries.text: It’s supposed to be a fearsome creature...\c\nIn this case, there’s no such thing as being\noverprepared![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_0050_camera_02

entries.text: Great! Now we just need some fog. Come on, we\ncan relax in the tent till it rolls in.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_0050_camera_03

entries.text: It’s finally time for me to capture the Bloodmoon\nBeast...on film, that is![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_0050_camera_05

entries.text: If things start to look dicey, I’ll be counting on\nyou to handle the battling, partner.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_0050_camera_06

entries.text: That hit we got on the Pokémon Searcher came\nfrom somewhere around here...[VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_0050_camera_09

entries.text: Are those footsteps? Whatever’s making them\nmust be huge...[VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_0050_camera_12

entries.text: It’s got a red moon on its forehead![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_0050_camera_13

entries.text: It’s the Bloodmoon Beast! It’s...it’s real!\nWe actually found it![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_0050_camera_14

entries.text: Now, you just be a good little beast and stay\nright there while I snap a photo...[VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_0050_camera_16

entries.text: I didn’t seriously think you’d go toe-to-toe with\nthe Bloodmoon Beast, let alone catch it![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_0050_camera_22

entries.text: You’ve got to work on those nerves a bit, bud.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_0050_camera_25

entries.text: Hah. But my heart is still beating a mile a minute!\nWhat a thrill![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_0050_camera_26

entries.text: I just couldn’t stop snapping shots of you battling\nthe Bloodmoon Beast![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_0050_camera_27

entries.text: I bet you want to give your Pokémon a chance to\nrest and recover though, huh, partner?\r\nLet’s head back to camp for now.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_0050_camera_28

entries.text: Packing up the ol’ tent and calling it a day feels\na bit sad...like the end of an adventure.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_0050_camera_29

entries.text: I couldn’t have done this without you, partner.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_0050_camera_30

entries.text: Because of you, I finally feel like I have some\nphotos here that I want to keep forever...[VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_0050_camera_31

entries.text: It’s been ages since I’ve felt this way. Seriously.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_0050_camera_32

entries.text:
And now that I’m all motivated, it’s time to ride
this feeling and seize the day!\c
I’m heading back to the village this instant to get
these photos developed![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_0050_camera_33

entries.text: As we always say in my family: “Time wasted is\nlost!” So I’m not wasting any more time![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_0050_camera_34
